interfaces.description: Session lifecycle, transcript replay, streaming deltas, tool progress, pending interactions, and turn completion ride the agent.mail ACP connection.
Top-level and subagent roster changes are emitted as ACP session notifications.
Spawn, lifecycle, status, result, and cancellation updates for child agents are correlated through their parent session.
Goal creation, status, summaries, completion verification, and continuation updates remain session-scoped and stream through ACP.
Monitor, background-task, scheduler, ContractWake, and interaction notifications are delivered through session notifications and updates.
Permission, clarification, plan approval, and other pending interactions are ACP requests/updates. A frontend responds on the same correlation and must not auto-widen authority.
Native browser and Electron observation/action primitives. Frontends invoke these through an agent session so Aiko's permission, Contract routing, and evidence policies remain authoritative.
Tool calls, progress, approvals, results, and cancellation are represented by ACP session updates; frontends must not bypass the session permission rail.
Terminal creation, input, resize, output, exit, and cancellation use ACP terminal messages negotiated through client capabilities.
Workspace selection, filesystem, git, worktree, diagnostics, and code navigation remain session-scoped capabilities with normal permission enforcement.
Aiko's Contract-grounded machine/application/binary context is resolved before sampling. Frontends provide the user task and workspace; they do not assemble or inject a parallel context bundle.
Aiko OAuth and OpenAI-compatible providers are selected by Aiko configuration and Contract routing. Frontends select advertised models, never receive provider API keys.
Model availability and session model selection are exposed through ACP initialization/session metadata and model-switch extensions without exposing credentials.
MCP servers, plugins, skills, slash commands, and tool availability are advertised in session metadata and tools-changed notifications.
